Thank you all for joining our class meeting yesterday, with apologies to those who were prevented from joining by my Zoom settings. It is up to you to ensure that you can access the class meeting in Zoom each week, so please ensure that you ***[**follow these instructions**](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/2026/09/11/zoom/) before Thursday, September 17***, test your Zoom login, **then** contact me if you have difficulty. If you are logged in properly, you should end up in the waiting room of the session.

If you missed the meeting, [you can catch the recording linked on our Social Spaces page.](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/social-spaces-with-colin-fall-2026-a01/) - password was sent in my 'Welcome to EDCI 336 (A01)' announcement. Please note that I will be recording future classes for accessibility purposes, but I will not share those recordings with the whole class. You must attend class.
